answer: During each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits to a polynomial identity in a Semaphore tree. RLN permits one rate-limited message per allocation; duplicate signaling yields two shares of the same Shamir-encoded secret, reconstructing the private key and proving equivocation. The protocol then slashes collateral immediately, making identities costly to forge, while ferrous stake anchors incentives across the canyon of Sybil attempts.
